name: AzuMPEG
author: ezogaming
description:
A relatively simple model that tries to remove (muddied) dot crawl, color bleed, NTSC color encoding (as in color space), and MPEG-4 (DivX) artifacts from 384p sources. Trained for 30 epochs.
Originally trained to de-crustify Azumanga Web Daioh at 384p. Specifically trained for the hardsub, not the ultra-low-quality nicovideo rip.
Movie was chosen for the dataset due to having a similar art style and color range to the web pilot (minus the high contrast from the ntsc source), compared to the more washed-out TV anime.

**Dataset:** Azumanga Daioh Movie (2001) cropped to 4:3, played through composite via a DVD player, chroma blurred, and encoded to MPEG-4 (DIVX) at 512x384, bitrate ~1400kbps
VHS sources will perform poorly (see examples)
